newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia August vehicle sales recover further.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia August vehicle sales recover further.

text.p: Indonesia's largest automobile maker PT Astra International said on Monday the country's total vehicle sales had risen to 27,813 units in August from 26,281 units in July.
A total of 34,544 vehicles were sold in August last year.
Astra said in a monthly statistical report the recovery was due to improved sales in commercial vehicles and passenger cars.
The report said passenger car sales rose by 24 percent to 3,055 units in August after declining steadily since April.
Astra's market share edged down marginally to 47.57 percent in August from 47.89 percent in July and compared with 56.80 percent in August last year, it said.

Astra said commercial vehicle sales rose to 24,431 units in August from 23,198 units in July. It said an upturn in passenger car sales seemed to have boosted the August sales figure. Exports amounted to 327 vehicles.
However, Astra's passenger car sales continued to decline in August after selling 1,731 units in March. Its unit sales fell to 937 in August against 1,222 in the same 1995 period.
Astra is the passenger car agent for Bayerische Motoren-Werke (BMW), Daihatsu, Peugeot and Toyota.
Non-Astra passenger cars sold in Indonesia include Mercedes Benz, Suzuki, Hyundai, Honda, Ford, Nissan and Mitsubishi.
Honda, Hyundai, Mercedes Benz, Mitsubishi and Suzuki posted sales improvement while Nissan and Ford sales slipped, the Astra report said.
Astra, agent for Daihatsu, Isuzu, Nissan and Toyota commercial vehicles, boosted sales in the commercial sector to 11,968 units in August, compared with 11,154 units in July.
A sharp increase was posted by Isuzu.
Sales of non-Astra commercial vehicles, including Suzuki, Mitsubishi, Opel and Hino, were 12,483 units in August against 12,044 units in July.
Total vehicle sales, including exports, in the first eight months of this year were 209,333 units, down from 250,650 units in the same period last year.
